S01: In the ancient city of Iolcus, a shadow fell upon the royal house.
S02: Alcimede: "I shall save you, my child."
S03: Death took his father that night.
S04: Beneath the cover of night, mother and son fled from Iolcus.
S05: They traveled to the land of the centaurs, half-men, half-horses.
S06: There the wise centaur Chiron welcomed them.
S07: Alcimede: "Keep him and teach him all things."
S08: The years flowed: Chiron taught him to hunt and to fight.
S09: Chiron: "A strong arm without a wise mind is only a stone."
S10: He grew into a brave and strong young man.
S11: In his breast the desire burned to reclaim his throne.
S12: So he set out for Iolcus, after his inheritance.
S13: In Iolcus, his uncle received him with a warm face.
S14: Pelias: "Sit, nephew. What is it you seek?"
S15: Pelias: "I will give you the crown when you bring me the Golden Fleece!"
S16: Jason: "Just tell me what it is, and I will find it."
S17: Pelias: "It heals every wound. But a dragon that never sleeps guards it."
S18: A vision opened: the fleece of the Golden Ram, blazing.
S19: And in distant Colchis a sleepless dragon kept it.
S20: Jason was not discouraged — he built a great ship and named it Argo.
S21: He gathered fifty sturdy youths — they were called Argonauts.
S22: And the ship Argo sailed out upon the seas.
S23: The trials were not long in coming: storm and walls of water.
S25: Many trials, many battles — and so far they endured.
S26: At last, after many hardships, they reached Colchis.
S27: Over Colchis ruled the stern King Aeëtes.
S28: Aeëtes: "The fleece shall be yours if you complete three tasks."
S29: But the king's daughter, the sorceress Medea, looked upon him differently.
S30: The first task: to tame two wild bulls that breathed fire from their nostrils.
S31: Fire and fury — but Jason did not yield.
S32: He bound them to a plow and made them till an enormous field.
S33: As the king had said, from the earth sprang forth dozens of warriors.
S34: And Jason vanquished them all, to the last one.
S35: The last task remained: the enormous dragon that never sleeps.
S36: Medea: "This potion will bring it sleep — at least for a few minutes."
S38: Jason stepped into the dragon's lair.
S39: He sprinkled it with Medea's potion.
S40: And the monster, for the first time, slept.
S41: The hero seized the Golden Fleece.
S42: The light of the fleece lit his face.
S43: And together with Medea, they fled to the ship.
S44: And they sailed back, toward Iolcus.
S45: They arrived before Pelias — and showed him his fulfilled promise.
S47: Jason: "I completed the tasks. The crown is mine."
S48: And so, Jason reclaimed his inheritance — with heart, fellowship, and one faithful sorceress beside him.
